newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson seeks Great Western holder records.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson seeks Great Western holder records.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co Tuesday filed suit in Delaware Chancery Court asking Great Western Financial Corp to turn over its shareholder records to Ahmanson by Thursday, March 6.
A spokesman for Great Western, the target of Ahmanson's hostile $6.1 billion bid, said it plans to provide the data before the week is out and before it is required by the law.

An Ahmanson spokeswoman said the information was sought to proceed with a consent solicitation to Great Western holders which it initiated on Monday. She said if the information were received by Thursday, the suit would be dropped.
